tokens.v: Full-bleed photograph filling the entire frame edge to edge with no border, frame, letterbox band or matte of any kind. The laptop lies closed, squared to the edge of a dark oiled walnut plank desk in a whitewashed plaster room, louvred shutters throwing hard parallel blades of 7am sun over the machined lid. Fine unidirectional brushed grain runs left to right over the aluminium, lighting up only inside the bright bars and going near-black between them so the pale silver wedge stands hard off the dark timber. 35mm at f/2.8, camera twenty centimetres above the desk behind the near corner, the machine running most of the frame width, thin wedge, single slim full-width hinge bar and two USB-C ports on its left edge razor sharp. HELM is laser-etched in wide clean capitals across the lid's centre, large and easily read, grooves flooding bright only where a blade crosses them. No hand, arm, cuff or any part of a person appears in frame. The left edge crops the shutter louvres, the top edge an unmade linen bed out of focus, the bottom edge the desk's near lip; dust turns in the beams.
